question.text: For presumptive taxation of derivatives trading, a person is NOT required to:

answer.text: Maintain books of accounts prescribed under Section 44AA or get them audited
Pay advance tax in a single installment by March 15
Accept the deemed-profit rate prescribed under the scheme

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.217, a person opting for the presumptive-taxation scheme is not required to maintain the books of accounts prescribed under Section 44AA or get them audited. The same source notes that such a person can pay 100 percent of advance tax in a single installment up to March 15. The Trap: The Section 44AA books and audit requirement is the specific obligation that the presumptive scheme removes, so it is the correct "NOT required" option. The other options describe obligations or features that the workbook does not relieve under this scheme. Note: Both the Section 44AA books/audit relief and the single-installment advance-tax payment up to March 15 are taken directly from workbook p.217.
